resources.string: Open a saved project file, or start a new one. Nothing is created until you choose.
Begin a CAD model from a sketch on a plane, or a sculpt on a prepared sphere.
Open a ForgeShape project (.forge) from your files. Nothing changes until it opens.
Nothing opened. Choose a file, or start a new project.
Choose how this project begins. You can add shapes, sketches and sculpting later.
Start on a flat sketch grid, draw a closed profile and extrude the first body. Sizes and depth stay exact, editable values.
Begin on a sphere already prepared for sculpting. Its exact source is kept, so Back to Construction returns to it.
Now sculpting a sphere. The Construction sphere is kept.
Could not prepare a sculptable mesh. No project was created.
Tap a plane to sketch on, then tap it again to begin
Draw a closed profile, then Extrude to create the project
Project created — %1$s is its first body.
Back at Home. No project was created.
This project has changes that are not saved. Choose what to do before leaving it — nothing is replaced until you decide.
Save the project to this device first, then continue.
Continue without saving. The unsaved changes are lost.
Export GLB — save the model as a .glb file
Could not export the model. Nothing was written; your work is unchanged.
Could not save the project. Nothing was written; your work is unchanged.
Project opened — %1$s. Undo history starts fresh.
There is no saved project yet — save one first.
That file is not a ForgeShape project. Your work is unchanged.
That project was saved by a newer ForgeShape. Your work is unchanged.
The saved project is damaged and was not opened. Your work is unchanged.
The saved project describes values ForgeShape refuses. Your work is unchanged.
Finish the edit in progress before opening a project.
Could not import that file — %1$s. Your project is unchanged.
it is not a GLB this preview can open
it uses glTF features this preview does not read
its geometry does not add up
Copy saved — %1$s. Your saved project is unchanged.
Could not write the copy. Your work is unchanged.
Project opened from file — %1$s. Your saved project is unchanged until you save.
Could not read the project to copy it. Nothing was written.
Diagnostics written. Nothing was sent anywhere.
Could not write the diagnostics file.
There is nothing to report yet.
ForgeShape closed before this work was saved. Choose what to do with it — nothing is replaced until you decide.
Open the work as it was when ForgeShape closed. Undo history starts fresh.
Forget it and start normally. Any project you saved yourself is untouched either way.
That unsaved work could not be read and was set aside. Your saved project is unchanged.
Unsaved work discarded. Your saved project is unchanged.
The viewport stopped and cannot restart. Your work has been saved for recovery — restart ForgeShape.
Older strokes were dropped to stay in budget.
That sculpt state is no longer available.
How ForgeShape looks and where its controls sit. Saved on this device. A project is never changed by these.
Appearance, handedness and how the gizmo is drawn.
Which edge the tool rail and its panels stand on. The model, its axes and every gesture stay the same.
Presentation only. Every handle keeps its touch target, and a drag moves the body by the same amount at any size.
Grid on — a 1 m reference floor. The model is unchanged.
Grid off — the model is unchanged.
Selection outline on — the selected body is edged. The model is unchanged.
Selection outline off — Objects still names the selected body.
tap an entity to select it, then edit or delete it
drag from one point to another
tap point by point; tap the first point again to close
drag from one corner to the opposite corner
drag from the centre out to the radius
drag the two ends, then tap the point the arc passes through
tap each point; tap the last one again to finish
Tap a plane or a body face, then tap it again to sketch on it
Tap again to sketch on the highlighted %1$s
Looking along %1$s. Tap to look from the other side.
The support plane is fixed once the sketch has geometry. Delete it, or cancel the sketch, to change plane.
Select an entity with the Select tool to edit its exact values.
Polyline — %1$d points, %2$s. Its points are not numerically editable in this version.
Length %1$s. Tap to type an exact length.
Length applied. The first endpoint and the direction are unchanged.
Polygon profile — %1$d points. Its points are not numerically editable in this version.
Finish the current action before starting a sketch.
Profile found — set the depth, then Extrude.
%1$d profiles found — choose one, set the depth, then Extrude.
Editing the sketch of %1$s. Finish to apply, or Cancel to leave it unchanged.
Reopen the sketch this body was made from. Nothing changes until you finish.
This extrusion creates a new body.
Grow the solid out of the other side of the sketch. The depth is unchanged.
Depth %1$s. Drag the arrow, or tap to type an exact depth.
Grow the solid out of one side of the sketch.
Grow the solid the same distance out of both sides of the sketch.
Grow the solid a different distance out of each side of the sketch.
Each side %1$s. Drag either arrow, or tap to type an exact distance.
Side A, along the sketch normal, %1$s. Drag the arrow, or tap to type an exact distance.
Side B, against the sketch normal, %1$s. Drag the arrow, or tap to type an exact distance.
That extent is not one this build can carry.
Edit the sketch of %1$s. It is still this body\'s truth, and nothing changes until you finish.
Unchanged — the values are already those.
The profile is open — close the loop, or tap the polyline\'s first point to close it.
The profile crosses itself. Redraw it without crossings.
No closed profile yet — draw a rectangle, a circle, or a closed loop.
Several profiles are closed — choose one in Sketch values.
Depth must be a positive length.
One profile lies inside another. Holes are not supported yet — extrude the inner one, or delete it.
Those three points do not describe an arc — they lie on a straight line, or two of them are the same point.
A spline needs at least two distinct points, and its two ends must be different points.
That edit would remove a face another body is sketched on. Edit or delete the dependent body first.
A length must be a positive number.
Lines meet at a fork — a profile is one loop.
A CAD Body cannot be sculpted in this version.
Added %1$s as a %2$s — it is now selected.
Added %1$s, but ForgeShape refused the %2$s and left it a box.
Could not add a body — leave Sculpt first.
Construction Undo does not act on sculpt work — return to Construction first.
That stroke was too large to keep in sculpt history and cannot be undone.
This is the only object — a project always has one. Nothing was deleted.
Could not delete that object. Nothing was changed.
Renamed to %1$s — Undo restores the old name.
A name cannot be empty. Nothing was changed.
Hid %1$s — it is still in the project.
Locked %1$s — it cannot be moved until you unlock it.
%1$s sits on another object’s face, so a copy could never be moved off it. Nothing was created.
Could not do that to the object. Nothing was changed.
Mirror across the XY plane, reflecting Z
Mirror across the XZ plane, reflecting Y
Mirror across the YZ plane, reflecting X
Mirrored %1$s across %2$s — Undo removes the new object.
Only a shape object with no sculpting can be mirrored. Nothing was created.
Resetting rebuilds the sculpt mesh from the imported mesh. The sculpting already made on this mesh will be discarded. This cannot be undone.
Isolate: show only the body being sculpted
Exit Isolate: show every body again
Mask: %1$d vertices protected from the other brushes.
Mask cleared — Undo puts it back.
Could not clear the mask. Nothing changed.
One finger on the model — %1$s; elsewhere it orbits.
The Construction shape changed after you started sculpting. Your sculpt is kept as it is — Reset Sculpt from Shape to start again from the new shape.
Resetting rebuilds the sculpt mesh from the current Construction shape. The sculpting already made on this mesh will be discarded. This cannot be undone.
Showing %1$s — a field is not a number and was left as typed.
%1$s selected — press Apply Shape to change the object.
Rejected: every dimension must be greater than 0. Object unchanged.
Rejected: a value is not a finite length. Object unchanged.
Rejected: a value is too large or too small to build. Object unchanged.
Rejected: Total Height cannot be less than Diameter — the two rounded ends alone are that tall. Object unchanged.
Rejected: ForgeShape could not build that shape. Object unchanged.
Rejected: every scale must be greater than 0. Transform unchanged.
Rejected: a value is too large to place. Transform unchanged.
Rejected: a value is not a finite number. Transform unchanged.
Now sculpting — the Construction %1$s is kept.
Now sculpting — the imported mesh is kept.
Could not prepare a sculpt mesh from this shape. Object unchanged.
There is no sculpt mesh yet — press Start Sculpting first.
A hidden body cannot be sculpted. Nothing changed.

Opens at 1 every time. Applying multiplies the stored scale; the multiplier itself is not kept.
Relative scale applied — the stored scale is now %1$s.
Relative scale unchanged — a multiplier of 1 changes nothing.

Rejected: %1$s has no thickness to resize. Body unchanged.
